title: Build a graph that can be resumed

exports.name: build_graph
exports.signature: build_graph(nodes: dict, edges: list[tuple[str, str]], routes: dict, reducers: dict) -> dict
exports.description: Assemble a runnable graph from named node functions, unconditional edges, routing functions keyed by source node, and a reducer per state key.

exports.name: merge_messages
exports.description: Reducer that replaces an existing message when the update carries the same id and appends it otherwise.

exports.name: run
exports.signature: run(graph: dict, state: dict, store: dict, thread_id: str) -> dict
exports.description: Run the graph to completion from a starting state, writing a checkpoint into the store at every super-step boundary.

exports.name: resume
exports.signature: resume(graph: dict, store: dict, thread_id: str, checkpoint_id: str | None = None) -> dict
exports.description: Continue a run from a saved checkpoint, re-executing only the nodes that come after it.
